notes:
### New
- **Edit playlists in Krate:** create playlists and folders, rename and
  delete them, drag tracks onto a playlist and remove them again, in
  Rekordbox's library or Engine DJ (hover for **+**, or right-click in
  the sidebar). Drag playlists and folders to reorganise them, and drag
  tracks to reorder a playlist.
- **Playlists in two-way sync:** playlists you make, fill, reorder or
  rename in Engine DJ now come back to Rekordbox when you sync.
- **Star ratings:** click the stars in the track list, or press 1–5 on the
  selected track. A rating is saved into the library you're viewing
  (backed up first); the others get it when you sync.
- **Primary library** (Settings → Sync): edits made in Krate in that
  library also go straight into your other libraries. With Rekordbox as
  the primary library you can also turn on **Sync automatically when
  Rekordbox closes**: Krate then keeps Engine DJ up to date by itself.
- **Undo a whole sync.** Sync → Recent syncs lists your last syncs;
  **Undo this sync** puts every library the most recent one wrote (Engine
  DJ, and Rekordbox with two-way) back as it was, in one step.

### Fixes
- Changes made in Rekordbox or Engine DJ while Krate is open now show up
  as soon as the app is closed, and re-importing a library always
  refreshes the list.
